c: Tonn'oddeeo rains down tunas from the top right, causing them to land on the floor and creating a lingering blue zone that spawns bubbles. They spin when falling and after they land, bounce to the left and stop, in which they can still damage enemies besides the zone.

Tonn'oddeeo has a 0.75 seconds Hitbox Delay, meaning that the same enemy cannot be hit more often than every 0.75 seconds by the same zone and tuna. However, because all active delays are reset simultaneously as soon as any one elapses, some enemies may get hit more often.
